arms.acquisition_registered: prompt surfaces from one acquisition share one component
arms.all_view_merge: all outputs for an event-window share one component
arms.exact_dedup: deduplicate identical evidence vectors, then count remaining vectors separately
arms.lineage_unaware: every prompt-surface output is a singleton component
arms.native_one_per_view: canonical surface only, one output per physical view

assay.purpose: technical and directional gate only; no test outcome is inspected

model_policy: analyze checkpoints separately; never fuse their evidence in the primary estimand
parent_interpretation: declared acquisition reuse; not a claim of statistical independence
question: Do repeated estimates of one physical acquisition and estimates from distinct physical camera acquisitions contribute different countable evidence?
resampling: 2000 paired bootstrap replicates; sample episodes within task and carry all descendants
stop_conditions: post-outcome prompt, support, threshold, model, or arm selection
